prediction_text: Direction: Barack Obama wins. The Democrat — Sen. Barack Obama, once nominated — defeats Sen. John McCain in the general election of 4 November 2008. The Saturn–Uranus opposition beginning on Election Day, last seen 45 years earlier, marks a break with the incumbent party and an insurgent/change victory rather than continuity: the younger challenger of the out-party takes the White House. Timing: decided on Election Day, 4 November 2008.
basis:
No tradition/system field appears on this card; decided by genre as a western astrology election assessment, the setting being a May 2008 news report of astrologers' forecasts.
Faces listed: main question answered; the card's stated configuration (Saturn opposite Uranus from Election Day, a configuration last seen 45 years earlier) is the trigger — opposition of the old-order planet to the change planet on the day itself is read for rupture/change of ruling party. The nomination face (Obama leading Clinton but not yet clinched) is listed and answered conditionally in the prediction text ('once nominated'). Anchor check: '45 years earlier' points to the 1963-era upheaval cycle; read straight as a change signature, reversal reading listed and rejected because the opposition falls on Election Day itself.
